commits.message:
fix(config): preserve comments and roll back failed installs (#969)

* fix(config): the editor and the loader read a config file by one rule, so an edit reads back as written (candybar-law-review-ibyq.562)

A text that holds nothing but whitespace and comments is no document to
either reader, refused in one set of words: read as an empty object, it is
what an editor's in-place rewrite shows between its truncate and its write,
and a click landing there would replace the file the editor is still
writing. A layer with no file starts from the empty document, and a click on
a file the editor refuses is refused naming the file.

An insert into an object holding only a comment keeps the comment. A `//`
comment ends at every line terminator JSON5 ends it at. Save-as-preset reads
the layers above through the loader's syntax stage.

* fix(install): plan settings edits and roll back incomplete installs

* test(install): preserve active forwards during installation rollback

* fix(install): exclude overlapping runtime and handler installs

* fix(install): prepare replacements before publishing under a recoverable process claim

* fix(install): name directories retained for concurrent SSH forwards

* fix(install): recover interrupted publications before retrying an install

* fix(install): preserve replaced directories during interrupted recovery

* fix(config): guard incomplete history edits and preserve strict settings JSON

* test(config): verify blank Claude settings fail at the shared read

* style(install): format the integrated platform lookup signatures
fix(menu): pin former wire pairs and verify their load diagnostics
fix(menu): retire saved selections that block recording after upgrade
